**Failure mode:** Connection failure (missing OAuth scope on the Gmail Connection)

**Where it went wrong:** Step 2 of the AOP, at the first tool call, `gmail.send_message` (transcript [2]). The Connection 'Purchasing' has only `gmail.readonly` and `gmail.labels`, so the send was rejected before it reached Gmail. The Agent then stopped correctly and did not proceed to Step 3, so no sheet row was logged.

**Evidence:**
> ERROR 403: Request had insufficient authentication scopes. Required: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send

> Gmail Connection 'Purchasing' granted scopes: gmail.readonly, gmail.labels.

**Fix:** Add the `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send` scope to the 'Purchasing' Gmail Connection. This is a Connection change, not an AOP change. Re-authorize the Connection so the new scope is granted, then re-run the PO reminder.

**Next step:** Re-authorize the 'Purchasing' Gmail Connection in Duvo with send permission, then start a new Run for PO 4500918821. Nothing in the AOP needs to change. I can also check the Connection's current scopes once you've re-authorized it, if you share them or give me access to look.

Note that the Run failed cleanly and did not send a partial or incorrect email, so there is nothing to clean up on the supplier side. Confirm that no reminder went out through another channel before re-running.
